author: DHANANJAY MAHAPATRA
description: The Supreme Court voiced apprehension regarding the extended duration of a criminal trial involving a Popular Front of India activist, who could face more than three years behind bars. With 700 witnesses lined up for prosecution, the trial has been severely delayed. The activist is charged with fundraising and supporting alleged terrorism, prompting the court to call for a swift resolution to the drawn-out legal proceedings.
title: ‘Criminal cases can’t have lifespan of turtle’: SC on activist’s trial delay

author: TNN
description: Indian telecom consumers may soon see network slicing come to life, as the telecom authority has released draft protocols for this groundbreaking technology. These anticipated regulations will enable different internet speeds tailored to various user segments, allowing telecom operators to set unique prices for services like 4G and 5G. This development follows appeals from prominent telecom service providers.
title: Trai unveils draft service quality norms for network slicing

author: DHANANJAY MAHAPATRA
description: The Supreme Court urged states to decide on raising trial court judges' retirement age. This move aims to align their superannuation age with that of High Court judges. States were asked to make this decision by September 2, dismissing financial constraint arguments. The court stated that retaining experienced judges offers financial benefits to the government. High Courts were also requested to support this age enhancement initiative.
title: Supreme Court urges states to decide on raising retirement age of judges by Sept 2

author: TNN
description: Air India has appointed Tewolde Gebremariam as its new CEO and MD. He previously led Ethiopian Airlines for over 36 years, achieving significant growth. Gebremariam will succeed Campbell Wilson, who stabilized the airline initially. The Tata Group aims for profitable expansion and operational excellence under his leadership. Gebremariam expressed excitement about building a world-class global airline for India.
title: Ex-Ethiopian Air chief Tewolde Gebremariam becomes Air India CEO

author: TOI SPORTS DESK
description: Rahane also pointed to the rapid transition in the Indian Test side. Within six months, India lost Ravichandran Ashwin, Rohit Sharma and Virat Kohli from the Test setup. Without naming anyone directly, he said a Test team needs more experienced players alongside youngsters.
title: 'Respect senior players': Rahane warns Gambhir amid India's Test struggles

author: Agencies
description: Iran and Oman have agreed on a proposed shipping route through the Strait of Hormuz. This agreement is a potential step toward reopening the critical waterway for energy supplies. A joint statement from Tehran and Muscat is currently in the final drafting stage. Sources indicate Iran would gain control over ships entering the Gulf via the strait. Talks continue, but finalization depends on third-party non-obstruction and detailed definitions.
title: Deal on Hormuz shipping route reached with Oman, says Iran

author: TOI SCIENCE DESK
description: Recent studies reveal that snake spines are now categorized into five unique anatomical regions. Surprising findings indicate that snakes have a notably short neck, which reflects their ancestral lineage from lizards. Additionally, this research highlights a newly discovered middle thoracic region that has adapted for movement, enhancing their abilities to burrow, swim, and climb. Interestingly, snakes have evolved their skeletons structurally rather than simply after losing their limbs.
title: Aussie snakes have 5 spine zones, necks just 7-12 vertebrae long

author: TOI ENTERTAINMENT DESK
description: Veteran actor Pradeep Rawat's son, Vikramaditya, broke down as he recalled his father's final moments during the actor's last rites held at Oshiwara Crematorium in Mumbai on Wednesday. Speaking to the media after bidding an emotional farewell to his father, Vikramaditya shared how the family initially believed the actor was suffering from a minor stomach infection before doctors diagnosed him with an aggressive and rare form of blood cancer.
title: Pradeep Rawat's son Vikramaditya recalls actor's heartbreaking final moments

author: TNN
description: The Lok Sabha recently approved the Bankers’ Books Evidence Bill, a significant update from an older statute. This new law modernizes the procedures for presenting digital banking records in legal settings. Despite opposition members’ protests and disruptions in the house, the government stood firm, accusing them of hindering religious initiatives and temple projects. Ultimately, the bill passed through a voice vote before the house adjourned.
title: Lok Sabha approves Bankers’ Books Evidence Bill without debate

author: ATUL MATHUR
description: The Rajya Sabha approved a bill to increase the Supreme Court's judge count. This legislation replaces an ordinance that raised the sanctioned strength to thirty-eight judges. The bill's passage aims to expedite case disposal and enhance judicial efficiency. It will also provide the Chief Justice greater flexibility in forming constitution benches. India anticipates its first woman Chief Justice in the near future.
title: Rajya Sabha passes by voice vote bill to raise Supreme Court judge strength

author: Agencies
description: A hefty four-tonne piece from a SpaceX rocket has made its way to the moon, crashing after an eighteen-month journey in the cosmos. This second stage of the rocket hit the western limb at Einstein crater with considerable force. Currently, lunar satellites are on standby to document the impact and examine the debris. Meanwhile, conversations are underway between NASA and SpaceX to address the risk of future impacts.
title: 4 tonne piece of SpaceX rocket smashes into moon

author: DIPAK K DASH
description: Dozens of Indian and India-bound ships are currently in high-risk maritime zones.  The government has facilitated the safe return of over four thousand stranded Indian seafarers.  Maritime authorities are actively monitoring distress alerts and coordinating rescue operations.  Financial assistance is being provided to the families of deceased seafarers.  The government remains committed to the safety of its maritime workers.
title: 25 India-bound ships in Hormuz; government set to evacuate 13 soon

author: KUMAR RAKESH
description: The government is pushing its delimitation legislation to increase Lok Sabha seats.  This bill also proposes one-third reservation for women starting in 2029.  Opposition leader Rahul Gandhi rejected the government's outreach for support.  The government may reintroduce the Constitution amendment bill soon.  Discussions continue regarding the Foreign Contributions Regulation Amendment Bill.
title: Centre renews bid for delimitation bill as Rijiju reaches out to Rahul Gandhi

author: TNN
description: Meta's CEO Mark Zuckerberg formally apologized to the Indian government over several operational missteps, including issues with paid content amplification. The acknowledgment of these errors comes as officials expressed concerns over the potential loss of safe harbor protection for the platform. As the government reassesses its child online safety regulations, Meta committed to implementing necessary corrective actions to address these concerns.
title: Meta apologises for ‘error in restricting PM’s video’

author: TNN
description: RBI governor Sanjay Malhotra emphasized that the costs of UPI transactions are already subtly included in operations. He expressed it is premature to introduce explicit fees for merchants. The priority lies in enhancing the payment infrastructure and increasing utilization. Any fee implementation should consider potential effects on user engagement and ongoing investment, as consumers do indirectly incur costs, albeit often unnoticed.
title: Consumers already bearing UPI costs indirectly: RBI governor

Hasina described the July Uprising as a regime change operation orchestrated by a mastermind.

author: TOI SCIENCE DESK
description: Researchers developed a sensitive optical sensor using cicada wings and silver. This natural structure boosts weak molecular signals significantly, replacing expensive manufacturing. Silver coating on cicada wings creates tiny gaps that amplify light signals. This technology could lead to portable sensors for detecting pollution and toxins. Future studies will test these sensors with real-world environmental and medical samples.
title: Silver-coated cicada wing amplifies molecular signals millions of times

description: In Siddipet, a chartered accountant tragically took his own life, burdened by heavy gambling losses. Employing helium gas, a method learned from online tutorials, he was discovered in a hotel room after the staff notified the authorities. His suicide note revealed the anguish linked to his financial plight, despite family support and efforts to sell his property.

description: A catastrophic event unfolded in Yadgir district early Wednesday as a suspected sulphur dioxide leak claimed the lives of three workers and left two others injured. The victims were migrant laborers hailing from Telangana and Madhya Pradesh, and the survivors are now under medical care at a nearby hospital.

Thanedar expressed gratitude for his service and plans to remain active.

description: Amid rising infighting, the Congress party has issued a stern warning to Punjab's dissenters regarding their involvement with internal 'sleeper cells.' Amarinder Singh Raja Warring, the state president, has promised that party members acting against Congress will face consequences, with no tickets granted to them. author: TOI SCIENCE DESK
description: In a remarkable ecological initiative, over 140,000 invasive goats have been eradicated from three areas of the Galapagos Islands. This operation, costing $10.5 million, aims to rejuvenate the habitat for native wildlife. Using judas goats fitted with transmitters, conservationists pinpointed the remaining invaders. Following their removal, the area's native plants are thriving once again, supported by continuous monitoring and protective measures.

description: Rashtriya Swayamsevak Sangh volunteers aided over forty thousand families in Assam's flood-hit regions. They provided rescue, food, and essential supplies to affected villagers in three districts. Medical camps were organized by the organization in collaboration with the National Medicos Organization. Volunteers also assisted with post-flood rehabilitation, including cleaning and agricultural support. These efforts focused on helping communities recover after the recent devastating floods.

author: TOI BUSINESS DESK
description: Tewolde Gebremariam takes over from Campbell Wilson, the New Zealander and former Singapore Airlines executive who was appointed in 2022 to lead Air India's transformation. description: The Reserve Bank of India has maintained its benchmark repo rate at 5.25 percent, a move likely to foster buyer confidence and stimulate housing demand. Experts believe this steady rate will promote home purchases and encourage investments in real estate. The construction sector and related industries are expected to thrive with predictable borrowing costs, especially during the festive season.

The property boasts soft neutral interiors that complement breathtaking mountain views, creating a serene retreat. author: CHETHAN KUMAR
description: New government schemes will offer significant financial support to Indian private space companies. These initiatives aim to boost domestic launch capabilities and global competitiveness for businesses. Subsidies will cover launch services, technology transfer, and access to ISRO facilities. The programs are designed to lower entry barriers and accelerate private sector growth. This support will make satellite data and infrastructure more affordable for Indian entities.
title: From launch to data, tech to Isro facility, pvt firms to get 30-100% subsidy

author: TNN
description: Punjab Police apprehended nine individuals, including four juveniles, in two ISI-backed terror modules.  Authorities recovered illegal firearms, petrol bombs, and a stolen motorcycle from the arrested suspects.  The accused were reportedly recruiting local youth for terror activities and conducting surveillance.  These individuals acted at the behest of handlers from the Inter-Services Intelligence agency.  The police operation successfully dismantled these cross-border terror networks.
title: 2 ISI-backed terror modules busted: Pistols, petrol bombs seized, 9 arrested

author: TOI ENTERTAINMENT DESK
description: Jana Nayagan has achieved a significant box office milestone, crossing Rs 300 crore worldwide. The action drama completed thirteen days in theatres, earning Rs 2.10 crore on its latest day. India net collections reached Rs 181.55 crore, while overseas markets added Rs 92 crore. The film's worldwide gross collection now stands at Rs 303.74 crore. This success follows a strong first week of Rs 153.55 crore in India net.
title: 'Jana Nayagan' box office collection: Vijay film drops 45.5%, crosses Rs 300 cr worldwide

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: Princess Eugenie and her husband, Jack Brooksbank, have welcomed their third child, a baby girl, making them parents to three children. The British royal family announced the happy news on Tuesday, a day after the baby's birth, sharing the first photograph of the newest royal addition.
title: Princess Eugenie welcomes baby girl, now parents of three

author: TOI SPORTS DESK
description: Mohammed Kaif believes Rohit Sharma will not retire from ODIs voluntarily. He suggests the selectors will make the final decision on his career. Sharma's recent century at Lord's indicates his continued focus on playing. Kaif also highlighted the need for clear communication from team management. The BCCI's timely statement prevented unnecessary speculation surrounding the match.
title: 'You drop me': Ex-cricketer says Rohit Sharma has thrown the ball into selectors' court

author: A SELVARAJ AND ANTONY FERNANDO
title: Udhayanidhi Stalin held for 'sexual remark' linking CM Vijay; freed on bail hours later

author: JYOTIRMOY HALDER
description: Savitha Shri Baskar never set out to become the family’s chess star. She first picked up the game by watching her elder brother, but soon became the one her father chose to back. He quit his job in Singapore, pawned jewellery and stretched the family’s finances to keep her career going. Now, at 19, Savitha is headed to the Olympiad.
title: Father quit job, pawned jewellery to fund chess dream: Olympiad-bound Savitha's story

author: AMIT ANAND CHOUDHARY
description: Court Also Suggests Such Vehicles Be Denied Fuel
title: 56% of vehicles not insured, SC says challan them

author: GLOBAL SPORTS DESK
description: Hailee Steinfeld is celebrated as Estée Lauder's newest ambassador for their latest fragrance, marking a thrilling chapter in her career. This announcement is particularly poignant as her husband, Josh Allen, embarks on training camp after a significant contract extension with the Buffalo Bills. With the couple now enjoying new parenthood with their daughter, Harper Haize Allen, Steinfeld navigates the balancing act of motherhood and her flourishing career.
title: Hailee Steinfeld celebrates another milestone after welcoming first child

author: NIKHIL SHARMA
description: A teacher was fatally stabbed by a man who had stalked her for two years.  He had previously abducted her and assaulted her husband, ignoring family assurances.  The victim had warned him of a police complaint if harassment continued.  The accused tricked her to the school gate using her husband's nickname.  Security lapses at the school allowed the masked assailant to enter the campus.
title: 'Stalker abducted her once': Faridabad teacher lured to gate before her murder

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: The Donald Trump administration has revoked the commercial driver's licences of more than 28,000 immigrant truck drivers as part of a crackdown on non-citizen drivers while launching a programme to replace them with US military veterans. The move could significantly affect thousands of Indian truckers, particularly those from Punjab and Haryana working in the US trucking industry.
title: US revokes 28,000 immigrant truck licences, may hit Indian drivers

author: SAMAD HOQUE
description: After incurring heavy losses in online gaming, a Delhi Police constable turned to ATM theft as a solution. He gathered a team and taught them criminal tactics through internet videos. Their efforts led to the theft of more than twelve lakh rupees from two ATMs in Faridabad. However, the constable was left empty-handed when his gang refused to share the loot.
title: Delhi cop loses Rs 6 lakh in gaming, scripts ATM thefts to recover losses

author: TNN
description: To comply with the upcoming Digital Personal Data Protection Act, WhatsApp is piloting new privacy-focused age verification methods for Indian users. This initiative is completely voluntary, allowing users to choose their participation. With the new law's emphasis on stricter regulations for children's personal data, WhatsApp is taking care to safeguard user privacy during this important verification process.
title: WA tests optional age verification pilot, says user privacy will be protected

author: AMIT ANAND CHOUDHARY
description: The government informed the Supreme Court about considering NEET's shift to computer-based testing. This decision awaits the Nandan Nilekani task force's report on public examination systems. Measures are being taken to make the exam more secure and prevent unfair means. The National Testing Agency has already moved seven major exams to computer-based formats. NEET (UG) currently remains the only major pen-and-paper examination conducted by the NTA.
title: Computer-based NEET? Govt tells SC decision after Nilekani report

author: DHANANJAY MAHAPATRA
description: Supreme Court urged prompt action against cyber fraudsters, while noting a reduction in incidents.  Authorities were directed to expedite decisions on a 'kill switch' for phones.  Monies transferred to mule accounts will be placed on hold by banks.  Victims will receive recovered amounts expeditiously after investigations conclude.  New directives aim to enhance cyber crime grievance redressal mechanisms.
title: Cyber crime reports down from 1.2L in 2024 to 16,377 now: Government

author: DIPAK K DASH
title: Crew rescued after India-flagged ship hit by projectile sinks

author: TNN
description: In an important meeting scheduled for this week, government officials will confront Meta executives regarding pressing issues. The discussions will center around the presence of child sexual abuse material, the rise of AI-created content, and the measures in place for takedowns involving notable personalities. Compliance with local laws and the efficiency of Meta's content moderation efforts, particularly in monitoring synthetic content, are also poised to be key topics of concern.
title: Government to grill Meta brass on child abuse, AI content

author: TNN
description: The government may allow a small charge on UPI payments exceeding two thousand rupees. This levy would apply to transactions made to businesses and not individuals.  Official estimates suggest this change will impact only five percent of all UPI transactions.  Most daily purchases like groceries and taxi fares will remain unaffected by this potential fee.  Industry experts anticipate a possible ceiling on the absolute amount charged for these transactions.
title: Government may allow fees on UPI payment above Rs 2k

author: TNN
title: SIAM says corrosion of vehicle parts due to high chloride presence in fuel

author: RAJ SHEKHAR JHA
description: Rizwan Hanif, a commander affiliated with Lashkar-e-Taiba, has alleged that Indian agents have systematically killed more than thirty individuals in different Pakistani locations since 2020. He characterized these murders as acts of religious persecution and rejected the authority of foreign entities. This statement comes amid heightened rhetoric from Pakistan's military, and experts suggest it serves as a strategic narrative amidst rising tensions.
title: Over 30 operatives killed by 'Indian agents' since 2020: LeT commander
